content.title: Gothic Classic Trilogy Dated for PlayStation and Xbox Consoles
content.text: The first game arrives on July 28th, followed by Gothic 2 Complete Classic on September 29th and Gothic 3 Classic on November 24th. Gothic Classic lands on July 28th for $29.99, with those who pre-order the remake getting it for free on consoles. But that’s only the beginning of the previously-announced Gothic Classic Trilogy. THQ Nordic has confirmed that Gothic 2 Complete Classic arrives on September 29th, while Gothic 3 Classic releases on November 24th for PS4, PS5, Xbox One, and Xbox Series X/S. Each title retails for $29.99 and contains adventures that are just as sizable as the original. Gothic 2 Complete Classic, for example, promises 500+ NPCs, more than 100 missions, and over 200 weapons and spells. Gothic 3 Classic only contains more than 50 spells and 100 weapons, but it packs in a massive world with “virtually no boundaries” to explore and “countless side quests.” Of course, for those who want a more contemporary experience, visually and gameplay-wise, Gothic Remake is out on June 5th, retailing for $59.99 on Xbox Series X/S and PS5, and for $49.99 on PC. Developed on Unreal Engine 5, it promises to retain the feel of the 2001 cult classic (right down to its various factions, dynamic world, and more) while improving the combat.
